facts.fact: 丈夫们没来警局——留家陪孩子，坚信 Keller 能搞定。

facts.anchor: She never looked at him, or anyone else like that. And never would.

facts.fact: Keller 今晚用细齿梳翻他们的人生——找需要埋掉的东西。
